description:
Note in Arabic script from Hārūn b. Nissim to Abū Isḥāq Ibrāhīm b. Bū l-Majd. Instructing the addressee to immediately deliver a half raṭl of قشيشة (?) to Abū Saʿd b. [...].

Verso contains detailed accounting in Arabic script and Greek/Coptic numerals.
description_he: פתק בכתב ערבי מהרון בן נסים לאבו אל-אסחאק אברהים בן הלאל.
